title: Grandfather's work and great-grandmother the wet nurse
summary: Grandfather's lumber job and politics; great-grandmother nursed for the Solari family.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Do you remember what your grandfather did, what his job was, or what profession, or- You mean my mother's father? Well, your mother, and then also the grandfather. My grandfather, well, you see, he worked as a lump- was a lumberjack, at Carleton, and
he worked as, I told you, as a Whitney Bank.
Your- your grandfather was, um, like I said, it's on the tape here, anyway. Um- Not Julian Monette, I mean my mother- Julian, that's right. Yeah, not Julian Monette.

I don't know what he did. But I know my grandmother had a lot of paper money. She used paper money even for nickels and dimes and those things. And she just had a great big box of his money. He was in politics of some kind, and some kind of Negro politician, I don't know what he was. But my son looked more like him than any one of my mother's children. Any one of my grandmother's children. My son looked more like my grandfather.
But you remember your grand- great grandfather's name, that you knew he was married her.

No, my great grandmother, you see, when I knew her, she was working for the Solari family. She was a wet nurse, and she- I mean, that's what they told me, she was a wet nurse. When I knew her, I didn't know her real well until I was 13 years old, because she lived and worked on premises, see. Yeah. Up here in Exposition Boulevard. The Solari's used to own a lot of that ground up there. They had a big orange grove. But I don't know what her- I know what her maiden name was, but I don't know what her married name was. Yeah.
I just wondered what the- if you knew anything about that great grandfather. No. So-

Dr. Crozant told me one time that the only Peche is he was a- was a bishop, and the bishop had a brother, so my grandmother might have- his name was Peche, Bishop Peche, and he had a brother. And my grandmother lived in Exposition Boulevard all the time. She traveled all over the world with the Solari's. Every time she had a child, Miss Solari would have one. She was a wet nurse. You see, a long time ago, they used wet names. Yeah, that's right. I heard about it. My grandmother, I know that she had one son, and one, two, three, four daughters. She only had one son, four daughters.
